## Cardinality type

How many targets a ref of a relation's `from` may have, and how many refs a target: `N:1`<!-- -->, a  track has one performer and a performer many tracks. A relation that says one target (`1:1`<!-- -->,  `N:1`<!-- -->) and finds two for a ref answers that ref `unknown: ambiguous`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Cardinality = "1:1" | "1:N" | "N:1" | "N:N";
```
